product_name: Motorola G96 (Pantone Dresden Blue, 8GB RAM, 256GB Storage)
description: ☆【144Hz 3D Curved pOLED Display】: Enjoy ultra-smooth scrolling and cinematic visuals on a 6.67" curved pOLED screen with 1600nits peak brightness, 10-bit colors & SGS eye protection. ☆【Segment’s Best 50MP Sony LYTIA Camera】: Capture stunning shots with the 50MP Sony LYTIA 700C sensor, OIS, AI Photo Enhancement, Horizon Lock, and 4K video from all cameras—rear & front. ☆【Snapdragon 7s Gen 2 Processor】: Experience seamless multitasking and efficient 5G with the powerful 4nm Snapdragon 7s Gen 2 chipset, built for gaming, AI tasks, and everyday performance. ☆【Vegan Leather Ultra-Premium Design】: Flaunt Pantone-curated vegan leather with a luxurious texture, lightweight body (178g), and ultra-slim 7.93mm profile for an elegant in-hand feel. ☆【IP68 + Gorilla Glass 5 Protection】: Be worry-free with IP68 underwater protection, Water Touch 2.0 support, and Corning Gorilla Glass 5 for enhanced durability and impact resistance. ☆【Massive 5500mAh Battery + 33W Fast Charging】: Stay unplugged longer with a 2-day battery and get hours of power in minutes with 33W TurboPower charging. ☆【8GB RAM + 256GB Storage with RAM Boost】: Multitask with 8GB LPDDR4X RAM, expandable up to 24GB using RAM Boost, and store it all with 256GB internal memory.
